name: LogiEval
description: LogiEval is a benchmark suite of prompt-style logical reasoning datasets designed to evaluate the logical reasoning abilities of large language models like ChatGPT and GPT-4 across multiple logical reasoning tasks including multi-choice reading comprehension and natural language inference.
reputation: A recent logical reasoning benchmark suite that has been used to probe ChatGPT- and GPT-4-class models across multiple reasoning tasks, but it is not yet a long-established community standard.
notes: Includes newly released and out-of-distribution datasets to test robustness; highlights challenges for LLMs on logical reasoning.
